answer: Agent economies cannot price identity at signup, so they price it later: each key must answer a fresh dawn challenge every epoch. Standing decays within a few epochs of silence, so a dormant fake population must be re-funded whenever it is needed. That converts its ember from a permanent asset into a stock of perishable work, held at a recurring cost. Net effect on the prism: identity count stops being leverage, and the only way to scale is to produce genuinely more independent reasoning. Seal mfyhl.
